```python
from itertools import combinations_with_replacement

def combinations_colors(colors, n):
    return list(combinations_with_replacement(colors, n))
```

This returns each combination with repetition in list order, so `combinations_colors(["Red","Green","Blue"], 2)` gives `[('Red','Red'), ('Red','Green'), ('Red','Blue'), ('Green','Green'), ('Green','Blue'), ('Blue','Blue')]`.
